text:
mira: ran a 6-hour KV cache bench across us-east-1 / eu-west-1 / ap-southeast-1 comparing kernel-A (fused-attn v3) vs kernel-B (tile-optimized) + prefetch/window tuning. short summary: kernel-A wins p50 for seqlen<=128, kernel-B more robust p99 for seqlen>=1024 in eu/apac. paging thrash visible on H100 when hitrate < 0.6.

raj: nice. what's the input trace / workload distribution?

mira: slen mix = 40% <=128, 30% 256-512, 30% >=1024. full trace uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/kvbench/195987 (internal)

jordan: did you compare persistent pager vs ephemeral pager? any diff on tail?

mira: yes — persistent pager reduced p99 by ~20% for long sequences in ap-southeast-1. ephemeral showed higher variance when eviction sweeps overlapped high-traffic windows.

kai: what eviction policies did you try (LRU/CLOCK/seg-LRU)?

mira: tested LRU, CLOCK, seg-LRU. seg-LRU gave ~2.5x fewer tail cache misses vs vanilla LRU for this mixed trace. eviction sweep interval = 30s, sweep batch size tuned to 0.05 of cache size.

sasha: can you paste the region/kernel p50/p95/p99 + hitrate numbers?

mira: pasted quick CSV below — these are median of 3 runs, 95% CI small except where hitrate << 0.7:

Region,Kernel,SeqlenBucket,p50(ms),p95(ms),p99(ms),hitrate
us-east-1,A,<=128,12,45,85,0.92
us-east-1,B,<=128,15,60,120,0.90
eu-west-1,A,>=1024,110,420,980,0.45
eu-west-1,B,>=1024,125,380,700,0.62
ap-southeast-1,A,>=1024,130,480,1100,0.38
ap-southeast-1,B,>=1024,140,360,650,0.66

mira: takeaway: kernel-B's tile kernels are more resilient under low hitrate (lower memory bandwidth per head, better fusion when paging). recommendation: default to kernel-A for short seqs (<=128) in us regions, add routing fallback to kernel-B for seqlen>=512 in eu/apac when observed kv_hitrate < 0.7. also bump prefetch window to 16 for apac long-slen workloads; persistent pager preferred when disk-backed hotset is >30% of cache.

raj: can we express routing rule + health check so this is automatic? we should avoid manual toggles.

mira: yup — prototype routing rule added to test cluster. snippet below (pseudo):

```
# routing policy (pseudo)
if request.seqlen >= 512 and request.region in ["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"] and metrics.kv_hitrate < 0.7:
    select_kernel("B")
else:
    select_kernel("A")
```

mira: plus a secondary health fallback: if p99(cpu) or p99(gpu_mem_pressure) > threshold -> failover to smaller batch size and switch kernel.

jordan: can you also include autoscale hints? kernel-B uses slightly more CPU but less peak memory bandwidth — may need +10% reserved on node templates in eu/apac.

mira: noted. adding autoscale and instance-type suggestions to PR.

perf-bot: benchmark run completed — artifact uploaded: s3://bench-artifacts/195987-bench.tar.gz (includes logs, raw traces, perf counters)

sasha: :thumbsup: looks actionable. please open PR with defaults + canary rollout plan. tag @eng-platform for autoscale templates and @eng-infra for image/kernel packaging.

mira: will do. planning canary next Tue, will include gating (p99 < baseline * 1.2, hitrate delta < 0.05). any objections?

kai: none from me. thanks for the fast turnaround.

mira: thanks — tracking in PR and will attach the full CSV + heatmaps.
